HOW IT WORKS

A clear workflow from start to finish

Saved customers and items reduce repetitive typing, automatic calculations keep totals clear, and every delivery option remains available from the same organized invoice record.

01

Choose your customer

Start a new invoice and select a saved customer so billing and contact details are added consistently.

02

Add products or services

Use saved items or enter descriptions, quantities, rates, taxes, and discounts for the work you are billing.

03

Review every detail

Confirm the invoice number, issue and due dates, payment terms, notes, line items, and calculated total before sending.

04

Send it your way

Email the invoice, share a secure customer link, download a professional PDF, or print a copy for your records.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Questions about lightning-fast invoicing

Can I really create an invoice in under 60 seconds?

Simple invoices can be created quickly when your customer and item records are already saved. Actual completion time depends on the number of line items, taxes, discounts, notes, and review requirements.

Can I reuse customer, product, and service details?

Yes. Saved customer and item records reduce repetitive entry and help keep names, descriptions, rates, and contact information consistent.

How can I deliver an invoice to a customer?

Use the supported email workflow, create a secure customer-facing link, download a PDF, or print the invoice.

Can I review the invoice before sending it?

Yes. Review customer details, dates, numbering, line items, taxes, discounts, payment terms, notes, and totals before delivery.

Can I track the invoice after it is sent?

Invoice records support clear payment states, including unpaid, partially paid, paid, overdue, and voided, so the next action remains visible.
